fieldData.content: Planned update of mainnet network gateway instances is scheduled between 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM GMT 22nd September.   The disruption is estimated to last for 5 minutes or less. Mainnet.radixdlt.com will be down and submission of transactions will be impacted for this brief period of disruption
fieldData.name: Network Gateway Undergoing Planned Maintenance 22nd September
